title: A perimeter analogue of Franklin's identity and an inequality related to the parity of parts
summary: We prove two conjectures regarding partition perimeter inequalities. It was conjectured by Gray, Payne, and Watson that Franklin's partition identity becomes an eventual inequality if one replaces the size of the partition with its perimeter. We prove this conjecture by asymptotic analysis of the corresponding generating functions. Gray, Payne, Swisher, and Watson also conjectured that there is a bias for partitions with fixed perimeter to have more odd parts than even parts.
